description: Fix a domain whose email goes to spam or fails SPF, DKIM or DMARC. Returns the exact DNS records to publish (host, type, value) for its mail provider, built from live DNS, in order, with the reason for each. Called without payment it returns a free preview of the fixes plus an x402 payment request for $0.25 USDC on Base (or 250 credits with api_key); a domain that needs no new records gets its advice free.

api_key.description: Optional VerifyPulse API key (vp_...): pays 250 credits instead of x402

domain.description: The sending domain, for example yourcompany.com

name: get_fix_kit
